title: Lamine Yamal just did what no footballer had done
sources: Ballon d'Or 2026, Palladium Theatre London, 26 Oct 2026: Kane 1st, Mbappé 2nd, Yamal 3rd; Kopa Trophy to Yamal for the 3rd year running, first player ever to win it three times (beIN Sports 26 Oct 2026; Yahoo Sports 27 Oct 2026)
Kopa winners: 2018 Mbappé, 2019 de Ligt, 2021 Pedri, 2022 Gavi, 2023 Bellingham, 2024-2026 Yamal (beIN Sports)

Born 13 Jul 2007; Moroccan father, Equatorial Guinean mother; grew up in Rocafonda, Mataró (postcode 08304, his '304' celebration); La Masia 2014; debut 29 Apr 2023 v Real Betis aged 15y 9m 16d; Euro 2024 winner; 2026 World Cup winner (1-0 a.e.t. v Argentina, 19 Jul 2026), youngest to win both; No. 10 since Jul 2025; Ballon d'Or runner-up 2025 (Wikipedia: Lamine Yamal; Yahoo Sports)
Laporta: 'I am convinced that Lamine will end up winning the Ballon d'Or' (Yahoo Sports, 27 Oct 2026)

scenes.text: He's nineteen, and he's just done something no footballer had ever done.
Lamine Yamal has won the Kopa Trophy for the third year in a row: the award for the best young player in the world.
Before him, Mbappé, Pedri, Gavi and Bellingham each won it once. Nobody had ever won it three times.
At the 2026 Ballon d'Or in London, he finished third, behind Harry Kane and Kylian Mbappé. A year earlier, he was second.

scenes.text: His father is from Morocco, his mother from Equatorial Guinea, and he grew up in Rocafonda, in Mataró. That's his 304 celebration: the end of the neighbourhood's postcode.
scenes.say: His father is from Morocco, his mother from Equatorial Guinea, and he grew up in Rocafonda, in Mataró. That's his three-zero-four celebration: the end of the neighbourhood's postcode.

scenes.text: He joined La Masia, Barça's academy, in 2014, when he was still a little kid.
scenes.say: He joined La Masia, Barça's academy, in twenty fourteen, when he was still a little kid.

scenes.text: He made his first-team debut at just fifteen years, nine months and sixteen days old.
With Spain, he won Euro 2024 and the 2026 World Cup: the youngest player ever to win both.
scenes.say: With Spain, he won Euro twenty twenty-four and the twenty twenty-six World Cup: the youngest player ever to win both.

scenes.text: Now he wears Barça's number ten, the shirt that once belonged to Messi.
Joan Laporta says he's convinced Lamine will win the Ballon d'Or one day. Do you agree? Tell us in the comments.
